authority: plan §4 F3a + measured fixtures (P0 light, commit 189285ab)
verdict: EODHD /eod `volume` is SPLIT-ADJUSTED (4/4 fixtures: AAPL 4:1 2020-08-31 raw-close drop 3.87x volume jump 1.20x; TSLA 5:1 2020-08-31 drop 4.44x jump 1.18x; CMG 50:1 2024-06-26 drop 49.85x jump 1.13x; TJX 2:1 2018-11-07 drop 1.98x jump 1.05x; adjusted_close smooth in all four)
rationale: same-basis law: volume is split-adjusted, so the price leg must be split-adjusted too; adjusted_close is the channel's split(+dividend)-adjusted price. The dividend component of the price leg is a uniform, monotone convention across all names and dates; the book is rank-based so level shifts are immaterial. Raw-close x adjusted-volume and every mixed pair are FORBIDDEN.
return_convention: r_i,d = adjusted_close_i,d / adjusted_close_i,d-1 - 1 (guarded: denominator > 0 and finite, else name-day excluded + counted)
